home.headline: SIMPLE
home.briefP1: SIMPLE is UNFPA's integrated SRHR data visualisation and programme intelligence platform, designed to strengthen monitoring, programme learning, evidence generation, and evaluation data management. It consolidates field submissions from three implementing partners — Centre for Injury Prevention and Research, Bangladesh (CIPRB), Bandhu Social Welfare Society and Partners in Health and Development (PHD) — into one live dashboard.
home.briefP2: Final programme brief is confirmed at the validation workshop on 3–4 June 2026 — this text will be replaced after sign-off.
home.coverageSubtitle: Each colour shows where one or more partners operate. Click a district to jump to that partner's page. Overlap shading flags districts where two or three partners overlap.
home.rollupSubtitle: Sum of achievement against the sum of all set targets, across every indicator in that partner's SIDA framework.
